Q3.decision: Both grok and claude drivers in v1; enable if binary resolves

Q4.decision: Prefer json when driver supports it, else plain

Q5.decision: Wait only, but almost every call would be bgtask. Tool needs to know this and likely very high timeouts and system prompt nudges to call it as bgtask
Q5.notes: Synchronous wait in tool implementation; operators/model should wrap via start_background_task for long runs; high default timeouts; system prompt nudge

Q6.decision: Default auto approve, can't have it blocking asking for permission
Q6.notes: Drivers pass non-interactive auto-approve flags by default (e.g. grok --always-approve / equivalent claude flags)

Q9.decision: No sandbox, but a way to give it a dedicated directory easily is desired
Q9.notes: No OS sandbox; first-class easy dedicated work directory (under workspace) for the child agent

Q10.decision: Defer resume/continue; always new headless run in v1

Q12.decision: Available on user sessions; optional disable for system agents

Q13.decision: Optional model field or allowlisted extra_args
